turnCompleted.description: The turn has ended. Sent as the last event of every turn, on the original stream and on every attached or resumed stream, so clients can end the turn on an explicit signal instead of inferring it from stream closure.

textChunk.description: Text Token (for streaming Gemini responses word-by-word).

mockResponse.description: Optional. The mock response / output to return if the tool call args / inputs match the pattern.

toolId.description: Optional. The name of the tool to mock. Format: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/apps/{app}/tools/{tool}`

TransferRuleDeterministicTransfer.description: Deterministic transfer rule. When the condition evaluates to true, the transfer occurs.

pythonCodeCondition.description: Optional. A rule that uses Python code block to evaluate the conditions. If the condition evaluates to true, the transfer occurs.

expressionCondition.description: Optional. A rule that evaluates a session state condition. If the condition evaluates to true, the transfer occurs.

cancelled.description: Whether an in-flight turn was found and asked to stop (directly on this task, or through an epoch preemption for a turn hosted elsewhere).

nextPageToken.description: A token that can be sent as ListAppVersionsRequest.page_token to retrieve the next page. Absence of this field indicates there are no subsequent pages.

webhookHeaders.description: Optional. The HTTP headers to be sent as webhook_headers in [QueryParameters](https://cloud.google.com/dialogflow/cx/docs/reference/rpc/google.cloud.dialogflow.cx.v3#queryparameters).

nextPageToken.description: A token that can be sent as ListAgentsRequest.page_token to retrieve the next page. Absence of this field indicates there are no subsequent pages.

options.description: The selectable options, in presentation order.

turnId.description: Identifies the turn being attached to.

displayName.description: Output only. Display name of the change. It typically should be the display name of the resource that was changed.

originalResource.description: Output only. The original resource before the change.

action.description: Output only. The action that was performed on the resource.

resource.description: Output only. The resource that was changed.

author.description: Output only. Email address of the change author.

sequenceNumber.description: Output only. The monotonically increasing sequence number of the changelog.

newResource.description: Output only. The new resource after the change.

acceptedOutputModes.description: A list of media types the client is prepared to accept for response parts. Agents SHOULD use this to tailor their output.

toolFakeConfig.description: Optional. Configuration for tool behavior in fake mode.

updateTime.description: Output only. Timestamp when the tool was last updated.

readOnly.description: Output only. Indicates whether the tool is read-only. If true, the tool cannot be modified by the user.

displayName.description: Output only. The display name of the tool, derived based on the tool's type. For example, display name of a ClientFunction is derived from its `name` property.

name.description: Identifier. The resource name of the tool. Format: * `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/apps/{app}/tools/{tool}` for standalone tools. * `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/apps/{app}/toolsets/{toolset}/tools/{tool}` for tools retrieved from a toolset. etag.description: Etag used to ensure the object hasn't changed during a read-modify-write operation. If the etag is empty, the update will overwrite any concurrent changes.

jsonPayload.description: The JSON payload representing the A2UI surface.

customFallbackMessages.description: Optional. The fallback messages in case of system errors (e.g. LLM errors), mapped by [supported language code](https://docs.cloud.google.com/customer-engagement-ai/conversational-agents/ps/reference/language).

maxFallbackAttempts.description: Optional. The maximum number of fallback attempts to make before the agent emitting EndSession Signal.

displayName.description: The file name shown to the user, e.g. "hotel_booking_tdd.md". Set on STARTED (and repeated on FINALIZED).

tokenUrl.description: Required. The token URL to be used for this flow.

refreshUrl.description: The URL to be used for obtaining refresh tokens.

scopes.description: Required. The available scopes for the OAuth2 security scheme.

deviceAuthorizationUrl.description: Required. The device authorization endpoint URL.

remoteDialogflowQueryParameters.description: Optional. useToolFakes.description: Optional. Whether to use tool fakes for the session. If this field is set, the agent will attempt use tool fakes instead of calling the real tools.

deployment.description: Optional. The deployment of the app to use for the session. Format: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/apps/{app}/deployments/{deployment}`
